description: Code-switched Bengali/English, which is how clinicians in Bangladesh actually dictate. The provider reports a BCP-47 tag ('bn-BD') to exercise tag normalization, and English medical terms are preserved inside Bengali sentences.
text: রোগীর blood pressure একশো চল্লিশ বাই নব্বই। CBC আর lipid profile test দুটোই করাতে হবে। Fasting অবস্থায় আসতে বলবেন।
